description: Find the right 765T Flow tool, or the how-to, for a Revit job. Describe the job in plain words, in English or Vietnamese. The answer ranks tools and short guides; each result lists the tools it leads to. When the catalog has no tool for the job, `answer.kind` is `negative` and `answer.workaround` names the nearest tools and what to do instead. Results are ranked for you to choose from; before you call a tool a result names, read that result with flow_get: a how-to card states what the tool does beyond its schema. `reference` lists up to three sections of curated Revit playbooks on the topic: background to read, ranked by wording only. It never changes `answer.kind`, never lists a tool, and is not proof that the catalog has a tool for the job. Read-only: it never reads or changes a Revit model. Never put project data, model content, file paths or secrets in the query.
name: flow_find
title: Find a tool or guide
